setup.title: You run this table
setup.lead: Choose the GM login and password. You can use them to sign in from another device too.
setup.noToken: Open the first-run link shown by the app on this computer.

login.title: GM sign-in
login.playersHint: Players sign in with the game link the GM sends.

play.title: The GM is waiting at the table
play.forgot: Forgot the password? Ask the GM for a reset link.
play.linkDead: The game has ended or the GM changed the link. Ask the GM for a new one.

reset.title: New password
reset.done: Password changed. Sign in with the game link from the GM.
reset.linkDead: The reset link has expired or was already used. Ask the GM for a new one.

home.gmLinkExpired: The GM sign-in link has expired. Restart the app or sign in with your password.

player.title: You are at the table, {{name}}
player.waiting: The map will appear here soon. Keep this tab open.

errors.no_active_game: There is no game right now. Wait for a link from the GM.
errors.removed: The GM has removed you from this campaign.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
errors.internal: Something failed on the GM’s server. Try again.
errors.network: No connection to the GM’s server.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.empty: No campaigns yet. Create the first one and invite your players.

game.linkHidden: The link is shown only right after it is made. To share it again, change the link.
game.replaceConfirm: A game is running in “{{name}}”. Starting a new one ends it and players leave.
game.rotateConfirm: The old link will stop working. Players already at the table stay.
game.endConfirm: End the game? Players leave the table and their links stop working.

participants.title: Participants
participants.empty: No players yet. Send them the game link.
participants.resetHint: Send the link to {{name}}. It works once, until {{time}}.
participants.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from the campaign? They leave the game and cannot come back with the link.

copy.manual: Copy the selected link manually: Ctrl+C
